name: Jari Mäkinen
bio:
Jari Mäkinen's journey into motorsport HR began unexpectedly. After a brief stint in the Finnish Defence Forces, Jari pursued a degree in Human Resources, initially intending to work in the tech industry. However, a chance encounter at a local rally event sparked a passion for motorsport, leading him to apply for an entry-level HR position with a small karting team. He quickly rose through the ranks, proving adept at identifying and nurturing talent within the high-pressure environment of racing. 

Now at ART Grand Prix Academy, Jari is responsible for overseeing all aspects of human resources, from recruitment and training to performance management and conflict resolution. His approach is characterized by a data-driven focus, using analytics to identify areas for improvement and optimize team performance. What distinguishes Jari is his commitment to fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment, believing that a happy and engaged workforce is essential for achieving success on the track.

Beyond his professional life, Jari is a keen ice hockey fan, regularly attending games and even playing in an amateur league. He brings the same level of dedication and teamwork to his sport as he does to his HR responsibilities, embodying the values he seeks to instill in his team members.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Jari is of average height with a slightly stocky build, a testament to his love of Finnish pastries.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers when deep in thought.
Insists on brewing his own strong Finnish coffee every morning.
